name: Network Traffic Capture
description: Placing a network capture device on the target LAN collects traffic that may contain plaintext credentials, NTLM hashes, internal service data, and network topology information. The Shark Jack performs automated network reconnaissance and capture during short deployment windows. The LAN Turtle maintains persistent capture capability for longer engagements. Captured traffic is analyzed post-engagement for credentials and network intelligence.

blue.det: Unknown device on DHCP logs; promiscuous mode detection; NAC alert on unauthorized port access.
blue.cm: Network encryption (TLS/HTTPS everywhere); NAC preventing unknown device access; 802.1X authentication on all ports; promiscuous mode detection.
